chatFlows.label: cost over plan
chatFlows.response:
Operating cost is **$31.6M QTD — 6.0% over plan**, and almost all of it landed in July.
{{chart:bars}}
- **Platform +$420K** — the annual cloud true-up posted in one month.
- **Production +$260K** — a one-off vendor invoice for the migration.
- Support and G&A came in **$170K under**.
> Net of the one-offs, the run-rate is only **+1.8%** over plan. Lead with that at 15:00.
